lesson.tree_through_seasons.title: Tree Through Seasons
lesson.tree_through_seasons.summary: Build an organic tree from trunk, branches and loose canopy shapes, then choose seasonal details that tell your own story.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.step.trunk: Begin with two gently uneven contour lines for the trunk. Trees can lean and change width as they grow.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.help.trunk_h: Start wide near the ground and let the two sides wander a little as they travel upward.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.complete.tru: Your trunk has an organic shape instead of a perfect tube.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.step.branche: Grow several branches away from the trunk. Let them reach in different directions while staying connected to the tree.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.help.branche: Think of branches as paths that split and reach toward open space.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.complete.bra: The tree now reaches outward in several directions.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.step.canopy: Build a loose canopy around the upper branches with a few broad organic masses. Leave some gaps so the tree can breathe.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.help.canopy_: Use big simple canopy shapes first. Tiny leaf details can wait until the story step.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.complete.can: Your broad canopy gives the tree a clear overall silhouette.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.step.season_: Now choose the season or story. Leaves, blossoms, snow, bare twigs and ground marks are examples—not a checklist.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.help.season_: Ask what time of year your tree is in, then add only the details that help tell that story.
lesson.tree_through_seasons.complete.dra: This tree belongs to the season and story you chose.
